findings.summary: releaseMergeIn only refuses an indirect invocation (sh -c, eval, xargs, node -e) when some token contains the literal word 'release'. AC1 requires wrappers to fail closed, as decisionMutationIn does. normalizeCommand turns every $VAR into an empty string, so `K=release; bash -c "node pipeline-cli/bin/cli-merge-if-eligible.mjs 13 --source-kind $K --arm"` passes the rule but the shell runs the release arm. Fix: refuse every indirect invocation that mentions cli-merge-if-eligible.

findings.summary: selectsReleaseKind only matches the exact tokens `--source-kind release` and `--source-kind=release`. (1) yargs expands camel case, so `--sourceKind release` normalizes to `--sourcekind release`, is not matched, and still selects release. (2) `--source-kind "$K"` normalizes to a bare `--source-kind` with no value and passes. Fix: refuse unless every source-kind option (match /^--source[-_]?kind/ after lower-casing, pair and = forms) has a literal value from the non-release set (backlog, gh-issue, decisions-sync, docs, deps); also refuse when no source-kind value is visible. Add tests for --sourceKind, $VAR and indirect without the literal word.
